# IBM Db2 TechX Summit 2026 — Project Submission

> **PR Title Format (required):** `[Submission] codefix-ai: CodeFix AI — Intelligent AI Coding Agent`
>
> **Folder Format (required):** `submissions/codefix-ai/`
>
> **Mandatory Next Step:** After opening this PR, submit the PR URL through the official Google Form: **[GOOGLE_FORM_LINK_TO_BE_ADDED]**.

---

## 1. Project Overview

- **Project Title:** CodeFix AI — Intelligent AI Coding Agent with Deterministic Static AST & IBM Db2 Persistence
- **Project Slug (must match folder name):** `submissions/codefix-ai/`
- **Short Description (1–3 sentences):** A full-stack, local-first AI coding assistant that combines zero-execution deterministic Python AST static syntax analysis, LangChain-orchestrated local LLM code generation, and enterprise session persistence backed by IBM Db2.
- **Problem Solved & Target Audience:** Solves the security, privacy, and hallucination risks of sending proprietary code to third-party cloud LLMs. Eliminates dangerous server-side execution of untrusted code by using deterministic abstract syntax trees before invoking AI. Built for developers, students, and enterprise software teams requiring private, verifiable coding assistance.

---

## 2. Team Information

- **Team Name:** CodeFix AI Team
- **Team Members:**
| Akanchha Rai | @raiakanchha07 | raiakanchha07@gmail.com / Full-Stack & AI Engineer |

---

## 3. IBM Db2 Integration Summary

- **IBM Db2 Edition / Environment:** IBM Db2 on Cloud / Db2 Community Edition (Docker / Linux).
- **How IBM Db2 is Used in the Solution:** Serves as the central persistence and audit store for every developer interaction. Stores original source codes, syntax error traces, generated code solutions, structural explanations, and model metadata across user sessions. Includes an automated transparent Setup Mode fallback for offline testing.
- **Db2 Connector / Driver / Framework Integration Used:** Official `ibm_db` native driver (v3.3.0) executing parameterized SQL statements (`?` parameter markers) to ensure zero SQL injection vulnerabilities.
- **Schema & Data Stored / Processed:**
  - Table `CODEFIX_HISTORY` with columns: `ID` (UUID PK), `SESSION_ID` (VARCHAR), `LANGUAGE`, `MODE`, `USER_PROMPT` (CLOB), `ORIGINAL_CODE` (CLOB), `ERROR_MESSAGE` (CLOB), `GENERATED_CODE` (CLOB), `EXPLANATION` (CLOB), `MODEL_NAME`, `CREATED_AT` (TIMESTAMP).
  - Composite Index: `CREATE INDEX IDX_CODEFIX_SESSION ON CODEFIX_HISTORY (SESSION_ID, CREATED_AT DESC)` for millisecond query performance when filtering history.
- **Steps to Verify Db2 Integration:**
  1. Initialize database schema:
     ```bash
     python -c "import database; ok, msg = database.init_db(); print('Db2 Schema Init:', ok, msg)"
     ```
  2. Run automated test suite:
     ```bash
     pytest tests/test_database.py -v
     ```
  3. Verify parameterized query execution and record retrieval in the **History** tab of the web application.
